item.travelersbackpack.auto_drink_upgrad: Automatically swigs water an' other drinks from yer pack to quench yer thirst
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_allow_: Allow these grogs (use a water bottle or bucket fer tank water)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_block_: Bar these grogs (use a water bottle or bucket fer tank water)
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_always: Take a swig when yer thirst bar ain't full
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_half_h: Take a swig when at least half its thirst-quenchin' power be useful
screen.thirst_was_upgraded.filter_full_h: Take a swig only when all its thirst-quenchin' power be useful
